description: Largest gainers or losers among Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) listed stocks for the latest session, ranked by percent change computed from the published close and change, with name, code, close, volume and value. ETFs, ETNs, warrants and preferred lines are excluded by default (exclude_etf). Answers "Taiwan stocks with the biggest daily gain", "largest and smallest % change among TWSE-listed stocks excluding ETFs and warrants", "today's top losers on the Taiwan Stock Exchange", "台股 漲幅排行". Main board only; only the latest published session is available.

date.description: Trading date YYYY-MM-DD. Only the latest session is published; any other date returns found:false naming it.

direction.description: gainers = largest % rise first (default); losers = largest % fall first.

exclude_etf.description: Leave out ETFs, ETNs, warrants and preferred lines, ranking listed companies only. Default true.

name: taiwan_daily_movers
title: Taiwan Daily Movers
